# Security policy

Paint Engine runs entirely in the browser: it draws on a canvas, makes no network requests and stores
nothing. Security issues are unlikely, but if you find one, please report it privately rather than
in a public issue.

**How to report:** use **Report a vulnerability** on the repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/alexandrewillame/paint-engine/security). Include what you found, how
to reproduce it, and which browsers are affected.

**Supported versions:** the latest release. Fixes are published as a new release.
